# KCC20 Wallet — for AI agents and dApps

Wallet: https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app
SDK: https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/sdk.js?v=169
Docs: https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/docs.html
KasDistro connect recipe: https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/kasdistro.html
CONNECT.md: https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/CONNECT.md
GitHub wallet: https://github.com/mrzeku2000XTTT/KCC20-wallet
GitHub SDK: https://github.com/mrzeku2000XTTT/kcc20-sdk

Hosted PWA, not a Chrome extension. Keys never leave the wallet origin. dApp builds the unsigned tx; user Approves and signs (PIN or KasWare).

## Connect (any site, including KasDistro and Nilla)

```html
<script src="https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/sdk.js?v=169"></script>
```

```js
const kcc = window.kcc20; // require sdkVersion === "169"
const accounts = await kcc.connect(); // user click only
const from = accounts[0];
await kcc.getNetwork();
await kcc.getUtxoEntries(from);
await kcc.sendKaspa({ to, amount }); // one KAS pay
// or signPskt({ txJsonString, options: { signInputs: [{ index: G, sighashType: 1 }] } }) then pushTx → { txId, node }
```

`signInputs.index` = global tx.inputs[] P2PK funding index. Never list covenant/curve/pool. After connect the popup closes on purpose.

## In-wallet apps (You → Apps)

1. TTT — https://tttz.xyz
2. KasDistro — https://kasdistro.com (logo: kasdistro-logo.png). Distribute KAS to many kaspa:q.
3. K Social — on-chain feed
4. Faceless Studio / Proof of Fact

KasDistro iframe: You → Apps → KasDistro. Same host-ready postMessage as TTT (`kcc20_browser=1`).

## Do not

Ask for seed, PIN, or 64-hex. Overwrite window.kasware. Use sendToken or buyKron for a KAS airdrop.
